info.title: Kantin Kwari Digital Market API
info.description: REST API for the Kantin Kwari Digital Market. Responses use the envelope `{ success, data, meta? }` or `{ success: false, error }`. Money is integer kobo (NGN). Real-time events are documented in docs/realtime-events.md.
